basic_info.description: Classic French Mediterranean Pacific Ocean view home tucked away on a wonderful block! Inviting, mature garden entrance w/palm trees & terracotta tile staircase leads to an impressive arched doorway & into a spectacular foyer w/center hall floor plan, stunning open-banister staircase & multi-color glass-paneled skylight above. Magnificent formal living rm boasts a gas fireplace w/exquisite original mantel surround, built-in bookshelves, hardwood floors & big picture window w/sweeping views from the Olympic Club & Lake Merced to the Pacific Ocean. Banquet-size formal dining rm w/striking chandelier & beautiful views to the garden! Tastefully updated kitchen showcases stainless-steel appliances, Carrara quartz counters, designer color painted wood cabinets & picturesque outlooks to the yard. Large, sep breakfast rm w/built-in china cabinet, bay window & snazzy light fixture, sep laundry rm. 3BR/2BA up incl the fabulous master suite w/dramatic ocean views & en-suite bath w/dual vanity sink, terrific dressing rm, two closets & built-in dresser drawers. Lower level enjoys a home office space & great storage. Lush, park-like landscaped backyard w/tradesman's entrance, walkway, flagstone patio, upper terrace seating, arbor, birdbath, blooming garden & a variety of mature plants & trees!
